# Staged release queue for .github/workflows/release.yml
#
# One "<version> <commit>" per line, oldest first. The scheduled job releases
# the FIRST entry that is not on npm yet, so the queue advances itself and never
# needs writing back to. Keyed on the registry rather than on tags, because a
# version can be tagged and released on GitHub while its npm publish is still
# pending — a tag-based check would skip it forever.
#
# To pause releases: comment out the remaining lines, or disable the workflow.
# To reorder or skip: edit this file. Nothing else reads it.
